title: defect-claim/v3
description: nodes/<id>/defects/<timestamp>-<contributor>.yaml, or targets/<id>/defs/defects/<timestamp>-<contributor>.yaml (D-16; F08-R7; F12-R4, Q7; F08-T17): a statement-defect claim, free and shaped. v3 (2026-09-23) adds one class value, `circular-decomposition`, and the field `ancestor` it requires: the node this claim sits under is no easier than `ancestor`, a node that depends on it transitively (read through D-8 revisions), and the exhibit declares exactly one theorem whose type is `<ancestor's statement> → <this node's statement>`. The gate checks both — the ancestor in the classifier, the exhibit's type in the sandbox (C9) — and a merged claim takes the node off the frontier with the cause `circular`; no record is rewritten. An `ancestor` on any other class is refused by the classifier. Everything else is v2's; v1 and v2 stay live and unedited (D-34), and the service files a circular-decomposition claim at v3 and every other class at v1.

stmt_ref.description: the node id whose Statement.lean is claimed defective, or defs/<file>.lean under the target

qa_exhibit.description: For a screen-finding claim: the path, relative to the graph root, of the exhibit file under targets/<id>/qa/exhibits/ that the QA record cites (F12-R15). Null on any other claim.

readings.description: For a screen-finding claim: the two things a derived falsehood can mean, named so nobody has to remember; the claim asserts neither (F12-R4, D-9 v3.12).

routes.description: A curator's routing of an earlier screen-finding claim in the same directory: which file, and which reading. With `misformalization` this claim's own class is the D-16 class the curator chose and a D-8 revision follows; with `refutation` the finding is a D-12 counterexample in waiting and this claim's class is whatever best describes the exhibit.

note.description: Free text; capped and served as untrusted data (F12 §7).

ancestor.description: For a circular-decomposition claim: the id of a node that depends on this one transitively, whose statement the exhibit shows implies this node's. Absent or null on any other class.
